paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise: in a subject capable of r, privation of r is exactly the lack of r in act: ∀ x r, CanBe x r → (Deprived x r ↔ ¬ InAct x r). It says nothing about incapable subjects (a mere negation is no privation).
